title: Organiser info page: race number retrieval at Run Experience, Porte de Versailles
publisher: A.S.O. — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris official website
claims: Bibs are collected at Run Experience, Parc des Expositions – Porte de Versailles, Hall 1, 75015 Paris; the fair hosts more than 150 exhibitors.
2026 opening hours: Thursday 3 p.m.–8 p.m., Friday 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; race bibs are not handed out on race day.
Collection requires the PPS number (or FFA license) uploaded to the timeto dashboard, the QR code from the confirmation email/dashboard, and an ID document.
Access: metro line 12 Porte de Versailles; tramway T3a and T2; bus 39, 42 and 49; Vélib' stations near the departure and arrival areas.

A starting-pen change can be requested exceptionally at the bib-collection information point, with a performance certificate less than 4 years old from an official race; Elite-range requests go to the SOS RUNNERS desk.
